quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: At any place where official traffic-control devices prohibit stopping, standing or parking.

activation.condition: Observed stopping, standing or parking at a place governed by an effective official prohibition.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park at a place where an official device prohibits that act, absent a statutory exception.

exceptions.source_clause: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
exceptions.description: Observe other traffic and why the halt was necessary.
Identify source law and actual compliant conduct.
Observe the officer direction and actual compliance.
Observe the distinct official direction and actual compliance.

timing.description: Compare original device effective conditions to each original halt frame.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Actual halt activity needs original motion and independent purpose.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Official device identity, exact instruction and governed place need independent review.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Direction and actual compliance need independent original observations.
